item.title: US Boosts Nigeria’s Anti-Terror Fight with Drones, Troops Deployment | African Examiner
item.description: (AFRICAN EXAMINER) - The United States has deployed multiple MQ-9 drones and about 200 troops to Nigeria to support the fight against Islamist militants, according to a report by Reuters. Officials from both countries said the US troops are not involved in frontline combat. Instead, they are providing training and intelligence support to Nigerian forces.
